review: Communications provider runtime concurrency and webhook integrity
scope: non-production WhatsApp provider handoff and signed webhook processing

correctedFindings.summary: Concurrent send requests could both reach provider transport because the persisted idempotency key was not paired with an atomic draft claim.
correctedFindings.correction: Provider transport now requires a compare-and-set draft-to-sending claim bound to the idempotency key; losing requests fail closed.

correctedFindings.summary: Webhook delivery callbacks matched inbox messages by provider ID without canonical sender proof, and values missing sender metadata could be processed beside a valid value.
correctedFindings.correction: Inbox status reads and writes now bind the resolved sender and company scope; every webhook value must resolve canonical sender metadata.

correctedFindings.summary: Webhook failures were marked deferred but returned 200 without any replay worker, so failed post-receipt processing could remain permanently unprocessed.
correctedFindings.correction: Durable receipts now use an atomic processing claim, completed duplicates stay idempotent, failed receipts are reclaimable, and post-receipt failure returns 503 for bounded provider retry.
